alt: A sliding-window minimum found with a heap of (value, index) pairs. Every index is pushed once. Before each window is read, entries whose index has already left the window are popped from the top and discarded, since they can never be the minimum again. The window's minimum is whatever valid entry then sits on top.

steps.caption: Push `(3, 0)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(3, 0)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
Push `(1, 1)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 1)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
Push `(4, 2)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 1)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The window `[0, 2]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(1, 1)`, is still inside it, so 1 is the window's minimum.
Push `(1, 3)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 1)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The window `[1, 3]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(1, 1)`, is still inside it, so 1 is the window's minimum.
Push `(5, 4)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 1)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The top entry `(1, 1)` has an index that already left the window `[2, 4]`. It is discarded without ever being read.
The window `[2, 4]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(1, 3)`, is still inside it, so 1 is the window's minimum.
Push `(9, 5)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 3)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The window `[3, 5]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(1, 3)`, is still inside it, so 1 is the window's minimum.
Push `(2, 6)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 3)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The top entry `(1, 3)` has an index that already left the window `[4, 6]`. It is discarded without ever being read.
The window `[4, 6]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(2, 6)`, is still inside it, so 2 is the window's minimum.
Push `(6, 7)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(2, 6)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The window `[5, 7]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(2, 6)`, is still inside it, so 2 is the window's minimum.
Push `(1, 0)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 0)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
Push `(3, 1)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 0)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The window `[0, 1]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(1, 0)`, is still inside it, so 1 is the window's minimum.
Push `(2, 2)`. The heap orders entries by value first, so the top entry is now `(1, 0)`, whichever index carries the smallest value.
The top entry `(1, 0)` has an index that already left the window `[1, 2]`. It is discarded without ever being read.
The window `[1, 2]` is complete. The heap's top entry, `(2, 2)`, is still inside it, so 2 is the window's minimum.
